GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide on pace. got outside leader 1000 metres. battled on very well. worked early # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on jumping. Was obliged to race three-wide without cover until passing the 900m when allowed to improve forward to settle outside the leader.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat last 12+ Lengths off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, battled on ok but never a threat # too far back
Bit Slow Out 1 length sat last 12l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after losing its near fore plate parading to the start and was reshod behind the barriers, and was passed suitable to race. Slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased to last 8+ Lengths off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind rnrs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1.5L clear, pushed along a touch turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and dropped out # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that it was not her intention to lead the event, however, after the gelding began well and displayed early speed, she was able to do so without pressuring her mount.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped by another rnr which shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 5 lengths. last turn. got to outside 300 metres. ran on strongly with winner # margin to 3rd
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rdr dropped whip passing the 150m. Shifted in and away from the winner, which was shifting in, inside the final 200m. Protested against the winner. Protest dismissed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Worked fwd & shared lead Two Wide . Stayed =lead Two Wide until rolled to lead on inside @ 1000m.Held lead on inside until pushed to quicken Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured & laid out Five Wide @ 300m. Headed @ 200m & faded in last 150m. # On-pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and made contact. When qtd regarding the gelding racing more forward, rider advised he was instructed to attempt to make his mount, which missed that start at its most recent outing, begin. He added it jumped away well but when initially trapped wide, allowed it to work forward to the lead and consequently his mount settled further forward than was anticipated.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home ok but never threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Missed the start (2L). Near the 300m was hampered.
